title: VC 2.0 Issuance Composer
description: Composes, signs (eddsa-jcs-2022, ephemeral did:key), and exports W3C Verifiable Credentials 2.0 client-side, with in-page verification and a ready-to-embed OCG Standard §23 vc-2.0 input-attestation block.

subject_id.description: Credential subject id (DID or any identifier string)

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer where the attestation's claims sit in a consuming chain's policy_parameters

credential.description: Signed W3C VC 2.0 with eddsa-jcs-2022 proof

input_attestation.description: OCG Standard section 23 vc-2.0 input-attestation block

receipt.description: OCG receipt of the issuance activity with execution_hash

mcp_tool_definition.name: vc_issue
mcp_tool_definition.description: Composes and signs a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0 with an eddsa-jcs-2022 Data Integrity proof over a locally-generated, ephemeral did:key — this is local signing only, not authoritative issuance: no registry, CA, or issuer authority is contacted, nothing is persisted or registered anywhere, and the key exists only for this call. Returns the signed credential plus an OCG Standard section 23 vc-2.0 input-attestation block ready to embed in a chain's policy_parameters. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/544-vc2-issuance-composer.html for interactive use.
